10105010.t: M.A.D. Hideout Office
So...
You want us to carry out the commission you received together?
And the commission is to rob a stationery company?

Exactly!
We're both suffering from financial troubles anyway.
So let's join forces and overcome this crisis together!
...Where'd you leave Seven? Why is it just you two?
She said she was stopping by somewhere else first.

I don't even need to ask.
She's probably getting her dopamine fix at some gacha machine.

Phew... I'm thinking the same thing.
It's not like we can switch her off every time she does that. Good grief.

Anyway, what do you think?
I believe it's a good offer for you guys too.

We'll devise a plan using information from the client,
and you'll move with us and provide support.
It's a collaboration between us, the brains, and you, the brawn.

In return, we split the goods fifty-fifty.
Simple, right?
It's simple, sure...
But why should we?

Why?!
The condition is that you get half just for coming along?!
When you don't even have work and spend every day sucking your thumbs!!

Why, you...
Could you go easy on the hard facts??
We'll handle everything from checking infiltration routes to unlocking the Vault and scouting escape paths!
Seriously, it's a job where you just need to show up!!
Is your plan really so perfect that you can boast like that?
My, my, looks like you've lost your memory.
I saved you guys after you got trapped in the Bunny Empire before.

And you want me to trust you?
Sounds to me like you're asking us to get trapped and die together.
A-Ahaha...

Aww~ You remember so well!
We're people who made it inside the Bunny Empire's Vault, you know~
Doesn't that mean our plan was actually brilliant??
You talk big for people who were shivering in fear while trapped.

In the end, you couldn't get out, right?
So isn't that practically a failure?

Ugh...
Hitting right where it hurts...
Vault heists are all-or-nothing by nature.

And like Lafine said, the plan was close to perfect.
We just lacked the quick thinking to deal with unexpected variables.
So you're recruiting M.A.D., who live and breathe improvising?
Pretty much.
It's a miracle you guys have operated fine until now, seriously.
I-It's not like we've always handled things half-heartedly!
It's just because Joy, our only action-oriented member, is away right now...
Lately, whenever a plan goes awry, our confusion has gotten pretty bad...
Yeah, if only Joy had been at the Bunny Empire too, we might have pulled it off easily...

Alright, say we do break into the Vault like you want.
What happens if we get trapped like before?
Ah...
Mhm...
See? You don't even have a backup plan.

So let's change the terms.
You guys rob the Vault, and if you mess up, we'll go rescue you.

Kind of like a backup plan.
How's that sound?
...And the reward?

Just as we agreed earlier.
Half of the goods.

We'd be taking all the risk!
If we fail, you're just planning to cut us loose, aren't you?!
Besides, you want to take half without taking any of the risk??
You just shouldn't get caught, then.
There are no guarantees in this world!
If there were, I'd have graduated by now!!!
Bragging about not graduating, real classy.
Hey!!!!

Thanks for rescuing us back then...
If not for you, we definitely would've had to work part-time as bunny girls...

But this job is just as big as that one...
We really need your help...!
Whatever, not interested.
Sigh... I shouldn't have rescued you last time.
Then I wouldn't be wasting my time like this, and I would've gotten to see you in bunny girl outfits.
...Why don't you just rob the Bunny Empire again instead?

We'll probably try again someday...
But right now is a bit impossible...
Then give me a heads-up when you rob it next time.
To help us?
No, to snitch on you, claim the bounty, and check out your bunny girl outfits.
Eeeek...!

Lafine...
I think we came to the wrong place for a commission.

But...
he's the most reliable person we know...
Hmph. Flattering me won't make me accept those terms.

R-Really?
Then under what conditions would you accept the commission?
Why don't you show me some sincerity?
If you hand over the underwear you're wearing right now, I might give it a thought.

Impure!!!
The commission is definitely canceled!!
W-Wait, Caren.
Would those terms really be enough?!
Lafine!!

But...
it's not that bad of a deal, is it...?
Back in the day when I was short on cash, I even did a gravure magazine shoot...
Compared to that...

Hand over that magazine!!
No, sell it to me!!
They don't sell it anymore!
Sigh... Hold on a second.

Anyway... If it's just that, I might accept your condition.
So...
You'll help us, right?

I don't know about Caren's, but if it's just mine...
For now...
Emergency! Emergency!!
What's with you all of a sudden? Things were getting good.
Seven is about to become a bunny girl!!!

10105020.t: Bunny Empire
It's way more crowded than usual...

What in the world is happening?
Could it really be because of Seven??

I don't know the details either. They asked if I was Seven's guardian
and told me to hurry over to the Bunny Empire right away...
It feels like getting notified in the middle of the night that my research paper got rejected...

The end of a dopamine addict is always predictable.
She caused trouble in the end, didn't she?
Just like that bread addict at our place.
Don't talk like that just because it's not your problem!
Our Seven... There's no way... no way... she wouldn't have...

Damn it!
It pisses me off that I can't deny it!!

Right.
Seven is more than capable of doing that...

I hope it's nothing big...
Sigh...
Oh! There's a crowd gathered over there!

E-Everyone...!
You can't come any further!!

Please do not cross the line~ If you do...
we will use force~
With security this tight, it really looks like a crime scene.

Yeah...
It looks like a bank vault that got completely cleaned out...
Let's go check it out first.
Ah, I-I told you that you can't come in...!!!
We just received an urgent message and came right over.
A-Are you by any chance the guardians of the Maid android?
Yeah. What happened?

Um... it's a bit awkward to explain out here...
Please step inside for now.
Just how big of a mess did she make?!
It would be faster for you to see it for yourself than for us to explain...
It's just so surreal, you see...
Seven!! What happened!
Ah, you have arrived, everyone.
We have been waiting for you.
Um... what exactly did our Seven do wrong...

Sure, she loves gacha, slot machines, and maids, and hates working...
but at heart, she's really a sweet kid...

Uh... hey,
coins keep spewing out of that slot machine over there...

Seven...
did you break the machine?!
No, I did not.
Because I am Lucky Seven!
Then did you hack it?!
Because I am Lucky Seven!!!

Sigh, you clueless amateurs...
Look closely at the slot machine screen!

777...?
What does that mean?
It is a jackpot.

What...?
Jack... pot...?

So...
does that mean she won?

Yes, that is correct.
It has been a very long time since we last saw a jackpot.
Two years, eleven months, and twenty-one days, to be exact...
You remember that way too precisely, don't you?
Because that is my job.

Per protocol, upon hearing the jackpot alarm, I controlled the gathering crowd, placed the winner under protective custody,
and subsequently contacted her guardians.
However, due to the sheer urgency of the situation, I was unable to provide a detailed explanation. My apologies.
How much is the prize money, by any chance...?
It will be announced officially soon, but to give you a preview...
It is 2,382,436,927 Credits.
It is 90% of the total amount accumulated in that slot machine and those in the same line over the aforementioned period.

What...?
2.38 billion...?

Ahaha...
Ahahaha....
Caren glitched out!!
How do you like my luck?
My intuition led me directly to this slot machine today!

Now everyone has no choice but to admit it.
I am indeed... Lucky Seven!!!!!!!
...Is there no tax on that or something?

None whatsoever.
All associated fees are covered by the remaining 10%.
Once the calculations are finalized, the exact amount quoted will be transferred directly to the designated account.
We would appreciate it if you could relax and enjoy yourselves here at Bunny Empire until then.

Now, if you will excuse me,
I must attend to the settlement and wrapping things up.
Please enjoy your stay...

Ahaha...
Ahahaha...

Mmm...
Seven, wake Caren up.
Understood.
You... must retake this class...!!

Gaaaaah!!!
I'm sorry, Professor!!
That voice sounded completely different from usual just now.
Apparently Seven recorded a phone call between Caren and her professor.

Wow... telling someone over the phone that they have to retake a class...
Pure villainy hits different.

Huh...
Where am I...?!

Have you come to your senses?
This is Bunny Empire.
And I am Lucky Seven.
Lucky Seven...!

Ah!!
What about the prize money?

She said they'll pay us after final calculations.
Until then, we're free to wander around.
Really? Then I guess we should wait inside for now.
What are you doing...
Slot machines, naturally!

Overruled!!
Stop testing my composure!
Should we look around inside for now then?

When else will we ever get to look around a place like this so freely?
There might be something fun to see!
You're just trying to find an infiltration route, aren't you?

Shh!! Seven handed us this chance on a silver platter!
There's no way I'm letting it go to waste!
If you snitch to Bunny Gloria, I'll hate you, so don't even think about it!
Make sure you stick right next to us!
Oh, is that so?
Eek! Why are you hugging me all of a sudden?!
You told me to stick right next to you.

Th-That's not what I meant!
Anyway!
Let's explore inside the casino together!

10105030.t: Bunny Empire
Mmm...
Why are you hesitating so much?
No, take a good look around.
A few of those Bunny Girls keep tailing us.
Since you get chased every day, you sure are good at spotting your pursuers.

I do NOT get chased every day!!
Only sometimes!! Very, very rarely!!!
I spot a few as well. Seven, how many are there in total?

Exactly 7 people are tailing us.
Because I am Lucky Seven!
You're only counting up to 7, aren't you?
I have zero intention of counting any further until the number reaches 77.
So anywhere between 7 and 76 Bunny Girls are chasing us...

That margin of error is way too huge!
No wonder you fail every time!!
W-Well, we haven't been caught yet, so it's not a failure!
Then again, we've never properly robbed a vault either, so it's not a success either...

If this were a sport, you could say we tie every time...
Ahaha...
Tying every time just means a 0% win rate.
That's a terrible record. Disband the team!

Ugh...
You're so ruthless...
At this rate, looking for a new infiltration passage will be impossible.

What a shame...
I was planning to explore every nook and cranny to draw a map while we had the chance...

But why are they following us like this?
We're just wandering around doing nothing.

Are you seriously asking that?
You guys are convicts.
Literal ex-cons who got caught trying to rob the secret vault right here.

I do not believe that is the reason.
Look over there.

It's them!!
The Jack...
Oh dear... Running around like that is dangerous!

Wh-What was that all of a sudden?
I feel like I just witnessed something incredible...
They have been taking care of the people approaching us for a while now.
I suspect they are attempting to protect me, Lucky Seven, the jackpot winner!

Oho...
Then what happens if we step outside Bunny Empire?

That would not be a wise decision.
The previous jackpot winner was beaten by a mob the moment they stepped outside.

Why?!
Being lucky isn't a crime!
People who lost money think the winner stole what belonged to them.
I really don't understand that mindset at all...
That's because you've never lost money gambling.

Heheh...
Understanding is not a product of logic, after all.
More importantly, the calculations are finished, and the funds have been transferred to the account you provided.

You are completely free to leave now...
However, stepping outside will prove dangerous in many ways.
Of course, as long as you remain inside, we will protect you to the best of our ability.
Sounds like you're telling us to live here for the rest of our lives.

That is not entirely untrue.
After all, you have the money for it.
You have more than enough to spend the rest of your life enjoying a delightful bunny life with the Bunny Girls here.

That sounds like an awesome deal?!
I vote yes!
I would also be perfectly fine staying here forever.
Enjoying gacha to my heart's content, hitting another jackpot... Isn't that perpetual motion!

We can't do that!
How could anyone live cooped up in one place forever?!
I haven't even finished making my own map yet...!

If I get stuck here...
graduating this semester goes down the drain...

Wait, no...
I'll never graduate for the rest of my life...!

Sigh...
I guess this is when the Fixer steps up.
Hey, you said earlier that we were free to wander around, right?
Yes, that is correct.

Then using that...
is totally okay, right?
Are you referring to the staff passageway you previously used to trespass while searching for the secret vault?

Of course you may.
Since your intentions are not malicious and the circumstances are exceptional, I shall turn a blind eye.

However, this is strictly for this time only.
Do you understand?
There you have it.

Whew... I didn't even dare to ask,
but the Fixer sure is impressive!
I wasn't here to steal anything back then, so I can hold my head high.
But without a map, how are you planning to find that passageway?
It's all stored right in my head, so no worries.
I never forget a path I've walked once!

Mmm...?
Can I actually trust this?

Nothing to lose by trying. But I can guarantee one thing...
we definitely won't get lost.
I had no idea there was an elevator leading to the basement in the staff passage.
If I'd known that, I wouldn't have gone toward the main Casino last time.

The Bunny Girls were charging from this direction anyway,
so you couldn't have used it even if you wanted to!

Hmph...
Fair enough, then.
But something just made me curious.
Why is Lafine taking the lead?

Usually, androids have better memories than humans.
So shouldn't Seven be the one who remembers the way best out of all of you?
Are you telling me to take the lead?

Absolutely not!
I would much rather follow behind while leisurely sipping tea!
My motto in life is, "Bust your asses for the androids, humans!"
She's completely hopeless...
Still, she's gotten better than before.
Before, she'd lie down claiming she didn't want to walk, so Joy had to carry her over her shoulder.
That was truly comfortable.
Except for the times she swung me around like a weapon, of course.
It was seriously incredible.
Seven held onto a pillar refusing to move, so Joy lost her patience and lifted Seven with one hand, right?
After that, she spun her around five times in the air like pizza dough, and ever since, Seven's been walking on her own two feet.

Is she a relative of Black Angel or something?
What kind of ridiculous strength is that?
Ahaha, if Joy were here, she probably could've smashed the Vault door open from the inside!

Everybody and their mother opens Vaults with brute strength.
I wonder if Vaults even serve a purpose at this point...

Anyway, we're here!
Let's go outside!

Before that... Seven.
Check if there's anyone outside.
Yes. Connecting to security cameras.

All clear.
It is safe to proceed outside.
What's with you guys? Acting so professional feels completely out of character.
The fact that we haven't been caught so far means we possess a decent level of skill.
Could you not lump us in with the dime-a-dozen petty crooks out there?

Exactly.
Alright, opening the door!
Nothing beats sunshine after all!
So, where are we?

In front of a building about 100 meters away from Bunny Empire!
Quite a few buildings are connected to emergency evacuation routes.
Memorizing all these underground passages woven like a spiderweb was a real pain, you know?

We came really far.
We should be safe at this distance.
Right! There's no way they'll ever figure it out like this.
It's literally like a magic trick where people vanish out of thin air!
Then let's finish what we were talking about earlier.
What are you going to do about the request?

Probably... pass on it?
Since we have money on hand now.
Right, the reason we hit the Vault in the first place was that we wanted to strike it rich and live comfortably!
With this much money, I will be able to spend the rest of my life doing nothing but pulling gacha.
Tch. Feels like I just wasted my time.
Still, since you helped us escape Bunny Empire for the second time, I'll send you a little something for your trouble.
We're billionaires now, so of course I can do at least that much. Heh...
Hmph... I'll hold you to that.

You're a capable Fixer,
so I'm sure you'll land another great request!
See you next time!
Yeah, stay safe going home.

Tch... Something feels strange.
Like it's not really over even though it ended...
Well, must be my imagination. Guess I'll head back and read some manga.

10105040.t: Big Boss! Wake up! Hurry!!
If you don't wake up... I'll do something naughty~ Hehehe...

Mmm...
What in the world is going on so early in the morning...
Big Boss, Theta is acting weird!!
It's not like Theta acting weird is anything new, so what's the big deal...

Well...
she didn't go on her morning bread run.
Holy crap, isn't that a sign of the end times?!
M.A.D. Hideout
And she keeps repeating weird things!
Is there anything weirder than Theta skipping her morning bread run?
It would be faster for you to check for yourself, wouldn't it?
P... p... puru... p... plain yogurt cake!!!
Isn't she... just saying what bread she wants to eat?

That can't be~
When Theta wants bread, she takes initiative and gets it herself.

True...
Normally she'd already be eating bread she stole from somewhere...
...From time immemorial, there have been two solutions when a machine breaks down.
Hit it really hard.

I already shot her a few times for that...
and she's still the same...
If I acted like that, would you shoot me too?!
Of course!

How many times do I have to tell you I'm delicate?!
Take me to Saverim instead!!
Turn it off and on again.

We've already turned her off and on several times.
But nothing changed.

That was actually possible in the first place?!
Where even is her power button?!
Oh stop~ You already know~
I don't know?!! I REALLY don't know???
Haa... Anyway, if it's not a hardware issue, then it's a software problem...

Hehe, it must be because she's lacking love~
Let's shower her with affection!
Can't I reboot you too...

Oh my~
What are you planning to do to me after putting me to sleep~?

Tell me about it...
What on earth should I do...

Fixer, emergency, emergency!!
Seven is acting weird!!
Stop picking my lock and walking into my place like you own it!

So what? It's an emergency.
I told you to upgrade your security if you didn't like it.

I told you I have no money.
Why don't you new-rich folks install a security system for me?

That'd make it inconvenient for me to get in, so no.
More importantly, there's something else.

She wasn't normal to begin with,
but Seven right now is way beyond that.
P... p... puru... p... Free Poker!!!

Looks normal to me?
She's just spinning cards in her head instead of slot wheels, right?

Seven doesn't play Free Poker!
She only plays slot machines at the Casino!!
Huh? Looks like your member isn't in good shape either...
Plain yogurt cake!!!

Plain yogurt cake??
Sounds delicious...

To think both Theta and Seven are like this...
Is it affecting everyone, whether android or cyborg?
I took a look around on the way here, and it was total chaos.
Anyone with machine parts seems to be experiencing similar symptoms, though the severity varies...

Wow... Total chaos.
At this point, it's a societal issue.
But why did you come looking for me instead of going to Saverim?

I solve problems,
but I'm not a mechanic who fixes machines.

That goes for Saverim as well.
If the problem is with mechanical parts, you can't expect a perfect solution there.
Fixing Seven requires going to an android specialist, and the cost isn't cheap.
You guys have plenty of money, right? Don't tell me... you spent it all?

Ehehehe...
We did spend quite a bit moving hideouts, decorating, and stuff.

We still have a decent amount left...
but it's locked in Seven's account, so we can't withdraw it right now.
You can break into a Vault door, but you can't access a bank account...

Those are completely different fields!
Physical security and network security require totally different approaches.
Simply put, it's like needing phone verification to open a phone account.
Well, we do need to fix Theta too...

That's our Big Boss!
You really know how to treasure your allies!
I-I'm truly touched...
What are you talking about? I just can't let the fastest hands among us go to waste like this.
When there's no work like now, who else is gonna secure our emergency rations if not Theta?
Mmm, I could've sworn Big Boss used to be the one nagging us about stealing.
You have to fill your belly and stay alive before you can even nag anyone.

Good point!
Then should we go grab some bread to fill our stomachs first?
Stealing bread is a bit...
Coming from someone who wanted to rob a Vault, pointing out stealing isn't convincing at all!
Rich megacorporations and poor small businesses are completely different!
I'm even poorer than those poor small businesses! I need some consideration here!
Huh? What's with this all of a sudden...

Fixer?
Did something happen to one of your allies?

How do you know that?
Don't tell me you installed security cameras or something?

Not yet.
And if anything, I'm only interested in your body odor rather than your private life...
Saying that with a straight face, huh? So?
A new malware was released through Humanitas' public wireless network.
Androids and cyborgs are probably 100% infected.

If it's that, Seven from Super Rich caught it too.
She's totally glitched out, talking about poker when she doesn't even play it.

I wondered why she wasn't picking up, but I see she was with you.
I actually just finished analyzing the malware in Seven.
It seems to gradually dilute the infected person's sense of self, throwing them into confusion.

As for whether it can be solved...
it'll take some time, but it's possible.

However, that method is strictly a temporary fix.
If the malware is redistributed, we're back to square one.
In the end, unless we find and destroy the source, it's not a complete solution.

So, where's the epicenter?
You contacted me because you figured it out, right?
You know me too well... Phew.

Of course.
But I can't just tell you for nothing.

Give me any piece of clothing you're wearing.
Soaked thoroughly with your scent.

You robber!!
Have you been corrupted too?!

If I had a mind to rob you, I would've ignored the malware
and charged one piece of clothing for every temporary fix.

You should be grateful to me for giving up such an efficient method
and considering your situation instead.
I'm so damn grateful, you brat.

Wait, is that really enough?
As long as Seven gets fixed, money is no— Gasp.
I already know you hit the jackpot at Bunny Empire, so don't worry about it.
Besides, what I want is something money can't buy.
Even if you offered all the money in the world, would you sell it if you were me?!
Says the person who collects other people's Panties without hesitation.
Tch.

What's with you guys?
Why are you suddenly coming closer?

You heard her, Big Boss?
All it takes is your sacrifice!

Oh my~ Stripping you? My heart is fluttering.
I'll be gentle with you~

You have plenty of clothes anyway, don't you?
We'll buy you more if needed, so just close your eyes and strip off a few pieces.
Wait a second! I have the option to take them off myself!

No, strip him yourselves by force if necessary.
He might swap them out or spray deodorant when we're not looking.
How low has trust in me fallen?!

I do trust you.
But that's that, and this is this.
Business is business, after all.

Damn it!!!
I refuse to be forcibly stripped with zero mood set!!
A moment later...
Great. Put those clothes in a box, seal it tight, and send it by express delivery to the coordinates I give you.
Okay, leave it to us!

Haa... Damn it.
I paid your fee, so hurry up and tell us the solution.
First off, the epicenter of this malware is a stationery company called Flumy, which heavily pushes Flurry merchandise.

The epicenter inside...
meaning, you just need to find the main server of their internal company network and shut it down.
Huh?! That's the place we got a request for a few days ago!
The place you asked me to hit with you?

Right. Could that request to hit their Vault...
have been asking us to prevent this incident...?

If we had accepted the request back then...
would this have never happened...???

Why dwell on what's done?
We have to move forward for now.
Keep acting like that, and you're never gonna graduate.
S-Shut up!!
Do you have any information other than the company name?

No, find the rest yourself.
You know plenty of people around, don't you?
For now, I'll try to block the malware from leaking into other cities.

I can contain it for about 24 hours.
Find a way to solve it within that time.
I feel like I've gotten dragged into another pain in the neck...
Well, but since you guys were planning to accept the request, you must've drawn up a plan already, right?
We couldn't...
What, did tasting money make you lose your edge already?
That's because we turned down the request, so we didn't get any of the necessary info!!!
How are we supposed to make a plan without any information?! Huaaa...

10105050.t: M.A.D. Hideout

So basically, I have to gather information, accompany you,
and handle any issues that come up?
You guys are truly incompetent...

Ugh... But if you just get us the information,
we can make a plan...

And infiltration is our specialty,
so we'll definitely be useful once we get inside!
I'll let it slide because of what you showed me when getting out of Bunny Empire.

Shall we talk over food first?
I feel like I need a meal in me for motivation to surge.
You're telling us to pay, aren't you?

Of course.
I'm providing information, so you should at least do that much.

Fine... As long as it's not somewhere too expensive, our wallets can handle it.
Probably...

I'll say it again, Seven's account is sealed right now, okay?
Got it??
If it's cheap and tasty restaurants, I know a few places! Want me to tell you?
Yeah, just tell us and stay right here.

Huh?? We have mouths to eat too!!
You're not planning to eat good stuff all by yourself, right Big Boss??
Who knows what might happen to Theta and Seven while we're gone?

That's true, too...
What a shame~
What about us?

You two come with me.
If either of you is missing, we can't make a plan.

Watch over those two who are down.
We'll be right back.
Yes~ Have a safe trip~
I'll be waiting for your call, Big Boss!
Donut House
First off, let's grab a quick bite here.
And pick up some donuts for those idiots back at our place.

This isn't a restaurant?!
Is this really enough??

Weren't you trying to cut down on mouths to feed?
I was sure you were planning to abandon those two with some decent excuse...
Should I do that right now then?

No! I love this place!!
Let's eat here!!
Yo, Fixer. F... f... French cruller!!

What's that?
Is that the Donut House's new way of greeting customers?

Th-This is not of my own Will.
It's been doing this since morning...

I went to Saverim for an examination,
but the line showed no sign of shortening...
Ah... You got hit too.
Does everyone with even a bit of machinery on them end up like this?
Do you happen to know the cause?

If so, tell me immediately.
I'll step in and p... p... plain donut!
I figured out the cause, but I don't have solid evidence.

Kugh...
In that case, I cannot make a move...
When I need official authority, I'll call you, so rush right over.

I guarantee it on my pride.
I'll bring Marcia and Laila along and back you up immediately.

Well then, I'll be off on patrol,
so enjoy your donuts.

Going on patrol in that state...
She sure is dedicated, our neighborhood idiot cop.

You really have broad connections...
Even knowing police officers personally.
Why did you two naturally hide the moment a cop showed up?

Haha...
It's instinct, pure instinct.

Still, I managed to buy donuts in the meantime,
so let's talk while we eat.

As expected of a grad student.
Your real-world survival skills are maxed out.

Shut it, it's survival instinct.
Anyone hearing you would think I learned this because I wanted to...
So, how are you going to get the information?
Before that, I think we should first hear what kind of information we actually need.
Ah! For that, we basically just need three main things.
The building blueprints, the CCTV locations, and the guard patrol routes.

So you don't need passwords since you can just pick all the locks?
Professional safe-crackers, as expected.

Stop calling us safe-crackers...
